tone_statements.citation: 孙瑾 [Sun Jin]. 2018. 野落𱎼语气声的声学研究 [An acoustic study on breathiness of Yeluo in Ge language]. 语言科学 (Linguistic Sciences) 17(3): 328-336.
tone_statements.quote: 由表 2 可知,野落[亻革]语在阳类调 2、4、6 中存在弛声,而这三个调类都是古全浊声母所在的音节,现演变为弛声清声母。 根据语言的“补偿机制”,为了与其他调类进行区别,这三个调类构成了弛声低域。由于野落[亻革]语有八个调类,古入声已经舒化,即阳入 8 没有塞音韵尾,已经合并到阳去 4 中。 因此[亻革]语野落话的三个调类阳平、阳上、阳去处在低域中且表现为弛声,并与普通清声态所构成的中域形成对立。这说明野落[亻革]语的阳类调存在弛声,并具有社会语言学含义的声调特征。
tone_statements.translation: As Table 2 shows, Yeluo Ge has slack voice in the yang tone categories 2, 4 and 6; these three categories are exactly the syllables that had Proto voiced obstruent initials, now developed into slack-voiced voiceless initials. By the language's 'compensation mechanism', to stay distinct from the other categories these three form a slack-voice low register. Since Yeluo Ge has eight tone categories and the old checked tones have become open, i.e. yang-entering tone 8 has no stop coda and has merged into category 4, the three categories yang-ping, yang-shang and yang-qu of Yeluo Ge lie in the low register and are realised with slack voice, contrasting with the mid register formed by ordinary modal (voiceless) phonation. This shows that the yang tones of Yeluo Ge have slack voice, a tonal feature of (socio)linguistic significance.
tone_statements.locator: p.334, section 3 '野落𱎼语阳类调的语音性质'; p.329. [亻革] in the quote = the character 𱎼 (⿰亻革)
tone_statements.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
tone_statements.n_tones: 8 categories (T8 merged into T4); values seen 42, 24, 33, 13, 55, 31

sources.note: Nothing on stress for Chong'anjiang. p.106 gives extent/population of 重安江次方言 (c.40,000; Huangping Fengtang/Chongxin/Chongren, Kaili Longchang etc.); p.107: '连读变调现象除重安江次方言外都有' = Chong'anjiang is the only Chuanqiandian sub-dialect WITHOUT tone sandhi.
